_provenance.notes: Implemented in 2005, the BSAI Crab Rationalization Program allocated Individual Fishing Quotas (IFQs) to vessel owners, processors (Individual Processing Quotas), and captains/crew (C-shares). It transformed a dangerous, high-speed derby fishery into a quota-based system. While vessel safety improved dramatically and seasons lengthened, vessel consolidation led to a 60% reduction in active crab vessels and the loss of ~1,000 crew jobs, deeply altering coastal communities like Kodiak and Dutch Harbor.

fisheries_covered: St. Matthew Island Blue King Crab

safety_impact.safety_assessment: Dramatic reduction in vessel sinkings and crew fatalities as derby race for fish ended.

economic_quota_value.notes: A significant portion of quota share value is leased to active vessels by non-fishing initial recipients.
